results.gsdl:
type Bullet @extends Area2D
    signals: hit
    state:
        damage: int = 1
type Enemy @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        hp: int = 8
rule Hit by Bullet target Enemy:
    when target.hp > 0
    then target.hp -= 1, emit(hit)

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    signals: dash
    state:
        hp: int = 3
        speed: float = 100.0
    rule Dash by Player:
        when self.hp > 0
        then self.speed += 25, emit(dash)

type Hero @extends Node2D
    signals: leveled
    state:
        nname: string = "hero"
        lvl: int = 1
    rule LevelUp by Hero:
        when self.lvl < 5
        then self.lvl += 1, emit(leveled)

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    signals: jump, hit
    state:
        hp: int = 3
        jumps: int = 0
    rule Jump by Player:
        when self.jumps < 2
        then self.jumps += 1, emit(jump)
    rule Hit by Player:
        when self.hp > 0
        then self.hp -= 1, emit(hit)

type Enemy @extends Node2D
    state:
        hp: int = 5

type Door @extends Node2D
    state:
        open: bool = false
        uses: int = 0
    rule Open by Door:
        when self.uses < 3
        then self.uses += 1
